Potato___Early_blight.recommendation: Remove lower infected leaves, ensure adequate crop rotation, and apply copper-based fungicides.

Potato___Late_blight.recommendation: High severity. Destroy infected plants immediately, improve soil drainage, and avoid wet foliage.

Potato___healthy.recommendation: Leaves appear completely healthy. Continue standard watering and fertilizing schedules.

Tomato_Bacterial_spot.recommendation: Avoid overhead watering, sanitize tools between pruning, and apply fixed copper sprays.

Tomato_Early_blight.recommendation: Mulch the soil surface, prune bottom leaves to stop splash-back, and use organic neem or fungicides.

Tomato_Late_blight.recommendation: Act quickly: prune damaged vines, keep canopy aerated, and apply preventative bio-fungicides.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.recommendation: Improve ventilation, lower relative humidity below 85%, and use resistant tomato varieties.

Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.recommendation: Remove infected lower foliage, avoid wetting foliage during irrigation, and rotate crops.

Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.recommendation: Apply insecticidal soap or horticultural oils under leaves. Release predatory mites if indoors.

Tomato__Target_Spot.recommendation: Improve airflow between plants, keep foliage dry, and apply targeted copper/mancozeb fungicides.

Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.recommendation: Use yellow sticky traps and insect netting against whiteflies. Remove and burn heavily infected plants.

Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.recommendation: Disinfect tools with 10% bleach, avoid handling plants when damp, and remove infected plants.

Tomato_healthy.recommendation: Leaves appear vibrant and healthy. Maintain consistent moisture and balanced nitrogen levels.
